items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: Count Basie asked to see me. And I said, “Wow, I’d love to meet him.” So he says, “Wow, young man, you sound really good” he says, “you know if we have an opening on the Basie band, would you like to come and play lead trumpet with us?”

ctx.x: That’s concerts that we do here at Hamilton. And I got Joe Williams on this side and Count Basie on the other side.
He asked me to play lead trumpet once. Count Basie.
